stage: Learning machinery and practice markets with known right answers
evidence: Phase 2 gate, agent registry, decision replays (all below)

stage: Size positions safely in a market with rare crashes (S6)
evidence: M2: 6/6 agents succeeded; typical size 3.04x against the best 2.93x; 0 deaths in 720 test runs. Earlier trial-and-error agents (Experiments 1, 1b, R-FL) all failed this stage.

stage: Find the known best position size (S7)
evidence: M2: 4/6 agents succeeded (4 needed); typical size 4.98x against the best 5x. 6 deaths in 720 test runs (holding the exact best size on the same runs: 1 in 120). The other two agents missed only the rule that size must end closer to 5x than it started.

stage: Claim no edge where none exists (S4)
evidence: M2: 6/6 claimed no real edge, as required. Caveat: 2 of 6 still held positions (0.98x, 2.06x) on chance drift. Harmless without trading costs, costly with them; the next stage tests exactly this.

stage: Profit from predictable patterns after trading costs (S1, S2, S3)
Real historical prices: train, then test once on sealed data
Forward test on a demo account (simulated money, real prices)
